reviews.text: It was wonderful to have Pepito at Bausers School. It helped me learn how to care for and train him during his early days

My dog was fresh out of the shelter when I brought her to Bauser. Christine and staff were patient and caring. Daycare was a good experience for my Maxi. She has since become quite a companion to me. Thankyou Christine, Jessica and staff.

Christene and her staff could not be friendlier or more helpful with Toby, the 8 yr old, 95 Lb chocolate lab, from NC. Ex-duck dog, on call 24/7, lived outside, “wide open” as my cousin says. (It’s his dog).  I brought him to Miami, to domesticate him, help him to live his remaining years inside.  Bauser’s Pet Training is making that possible. We love Toby, but so does his dad, Cade. There’s still work to be done, and Toby couldn’t be in better hands than Christene and staff.  You guys are the best. ❤️🐾❤️

Amazing very knowledgeable, caring & patient animal behaviorist trainers a huge difference in my rescue dog Lenny's behavior  german shepard belgian malinois mix in just a short period of time.... Lenny loves coming to school ! Thank you Christine
Great puppy training program. Recommend to everyone who needs it.

Very impressed with Christine and her vast knowledge and experience with pet training, I am so impressed I will be sure to tell my friends and clients about her services. I think I may want to go get a dog for Christine to train.

My Cavapoo, Luna, has been attending since she was 4 months old, and in just one month she has learned so much. Kaitlyn and Liz are absolutely incredible with the dogs — Luna adores them so much that sometimes I think she’d rather stay with them than come home with me (which definitely makes me a little jealous lol).
Their patience, knowledge, and training approach have made such a huge difference in Luna’s confidence and behavior. You can truly see how much they care about every dog they work with.
Christine, the owner, is also extremely knowledgeable and has been an amazing resource for guidance, education, and enrichment ideas to support Luna’s growth and overall well-being.
Choosing this program for Luna was one of the best decisions I could have made, and I would highly recommend it to anyone looking for quality training and genuine care for their pet.
Hi Alma. We are so happy to see your 5 start review for your dog Sultan. He is such a love. Thank you so much. Can you let us know what is your favorite service that we have provided for you? 🤩 …

We’ve been working with Lauren at Bauser’s since summer 2024, and the progress with Bacardí has been incredible. Lauren is knowledgeable, patient, and truly takes the time to understand both the dog and the owner. Her training approach is structured but flexible, which made it easy to stay consistent at home.

Bacardí has become more confident, responsive, and well-behaved thanks to her guidance. What I appreciate most is how she explains the “why” behind each technique—it really builds trust in the process.

Highly recommend Lauren to anyone looking for effective, thoughtful, and results-driven dog training.

If I could give Bausers more than five stars, I wouldn’t hesitate.
Finding someone you genuinely trust with your dog is harder than it sounds — but Bausers didn’t just meet our expectations, they redefined them. Here’s why we keep coming back:
Real trust, not just good vibes. We don’t simply like Bausers — we trust them completely. The moment we walk through their doors, the worry disappears. That kind of peace of mind is rare, and we don’t take it for granted.
They actually love what they do. You can tell the difference between someone who works with animals and someone who gets them. The team at Bausers is the latter. Aspen has genuinely blossomed under their care in ways we didn’t expect.
Worth every mile. We drive an hour each way — and we’d do it again without a second thought. When a place earns this level of loyalty, distance stops being a factor.
If you want a team that’s professional, skilled, and truly compassionate, this is it. Aspen is part of the Bausers family now, and honestly, so are we.
Thank you for being Aspen’s home away from home. 🐾

Christine and her staff run a top notch facility! We enjoy bringing our five-year-old Shih Poo to Bauser's for enrichment and the Fun Friday events. They are well run and I especially like the report card, pictures, and videos that are emailed to us at the end of the session. It's nice to see what our dog was doing throughout the day. I've included a picture of Milo from Valentine's Day (one of the Fun Friday events).

Christine was incredibly helpful as my dog adjusted to a new environment. She was thoughtful, caring, and generous with her guidance. She offered practical suggestions tailored to my dog and shared many useful resources, including items to purchase both online and locally. I felt supported and well-informed, and I’m very grateful for her help.
Hi Rochelle. Olive and Grover are so lucky to have you as a mom. Keep up the good work. The consistency will pay off in the long run. ✌️💞🐶 …
Lots of fun doing the levels and backyard agility classes! My dog and I enjoy learning and doing activities at Bausers! Clicker training and positive reinforcement is effective!

I take my dog’s training very seriously and I can confidently recommend Bausers. They provide a multitude of services depending on your needs and goals. All the trainers I’ve worked with have been very knowledgeable and have unique insights. They have even supported me when I started trying different training methodologies. They are very easy to work with and genuinely care about your dogs well being: I would/have trusted them to take care of my pup when I’m not there. Happy training!
I recommended Bauser’s Pet Training to a client who has used them for their 2 dogs. They were extremely happy with the services they were provided. Aaa+++

Christine and her team are extraordinary. Their methodology and skills, from training, enrichment days, and extracurricular activities, have been an excellent tool for Ramon's behavior. (9 months golden doodle). I can trust my furry love is in good hands.

About three months ago I was looking to get some help for my brand new 10 week old bullterrier puppy Luna. She is a sweet dog but very stubborn and was systematically chewing every piece of wood in the house, doing a lot of nipping/biting And had a couple  accidents in the house. I went online and found BAUSERS Pet training in North Miami and went by to talk with the owner Christine.    From the very first meeting I  Knew that she was a very caring person and in it for her love of Dogs. Luna has truly Blossomed under the training here and has lots of fun every day socializing with her dog pound friends And learning new things .  I didn't know a place existed that you could bring your dog in the morning and pick them up in the evening and they are able to get one on one training as well as interactions with other dogs and people to help with their socialization. If I could give them more than five stars I would.... as they have done a phenomenal job!!! I highly recommend anyone that has any kind of an issue with their puppy or dog  To bring them to Bausers.... They treat them just like as if it were their own and you will not be disappointed with the results🐾👏💯🤩🐾
We’ve had a great experience here both with day training and also group classes with our new dog. Highly recommend!

Absolutely love this place. My puppy has reactivity issues and when was  without me was really shy and nervous around other ppl and dogs. I started to bring him to here twice a week for half-enrichment days where he gets to socialise and there was a lot of progress so we decided to switch to full days twice a week. Now he’s super playful and loves most of his friend-dogs. For me it’s really important that Christine and Jessica are very gentle and don’t push him out of his comfort zone,but at the same time encourage him to play and socialise.Not only that if I have any questions or concerns about him outside of socialisation, they will always help me with advice and tell me what to do which absolutely love. Also to track progress they use an app where they upload pictures and videos taken throughout the day and just comparing the beginning and what we see now it’s incredible. You can definitely see that the people who work here absolutely love dogs, treat them with respect, kindness and not just doing this for money. Would definitely recommend 10/10

I was referred here and worked with their trainer Rae for a board and train for 1 week while I was gone. I'm currently fostering a pitbull that I found on the street about 3 months ago in hopes of getting her trained and adopted. She took her in as if she was her own and I appreciated that. We're both used to working with reactive dogs and she knows what patience / training is required to give them the best chance possible. Thank you!
Hi Anne. OMG thank you for the review. You, Joe, and Biscuit have been with me since she was a tiny pup and now she is 14 years old and the best behaved dog. You all are amazing. 🤩  …
Amazing class , Great knowledge about dogs  and they give you great training they are super helpful and friendly. We felt really comfortable with them . Our dog Teddy was learning  a lot .

Hi Violeta and Sky. Such a beautiful Samoyed he is. He has truly come a long way so far with getting over a lot of his fear. He is socializing very well with the other dogs now and allowing us to pet him as well. We can see how smart he is. Keep up the good work! 🤩 …

I was originally referred here. I was apprehensive about leaving my dog because I knew how hyper he was. This place has taught me so much about how to manage him. He's just been there for a week, and I adore them. I am so glad I gave this a home. The staff is extremely nice, and they make me feel like a member of the family. I know he has gentle, caring hands. I recommend this establishment. If you want your pet trained and afraid to be left alone, I encourage you to give this staff a chance. You will have no regrets.

Hi. I would love to know who you are. I'm sorry I do not understand the language being used for this review. Thank you very much for the 5 start review. It is greatly appreciated. Which service did you use? : )

My personal experience has been excellent. The entire staff here is highly trained. They've played an important role in Mia's training and to be honest, she's doing very well. Now I have a new challenge with my new dog, Luna. I'm sure they are going to help  me with this new challenge. I have taken 3 dogs to Bauser’s classes . Snickers is my latest dog that completed Level 1. He is a rescue dog and was very skittish . By working with the trainers , Snickers learned to trust and at his last class he even allowed the trainer Kerven to rub his belly . Quite the progress for this little guy . Besides the group classes, the  best event my pups attended was the St. Patrick’s Day Fun Day . They had a costume contest and a pup pot of gold (ball pit) with a rainbow over the pot of gold . They had little obstacles for the pups to go on and the pups came back from the day thoroughly exhausted !!! I love this place !
Great job.
Communicative, professional and great with my dog. She actually gets excited when she realizes that’s where she’s going - and I am seeing the results of the training
Best pet people ever!!! So impressed my dog loves it. Christine is also amazing she loves your pet like her own! My dog has learned so much, thank you BAUSERS xoxo
Love it🥰🥰🥰 …

Best pet training ever!!! The love is real! Christine loves her little students and knows how to train them. She is there for you with questions and challenges because she understands that each pup is unique and reacts differently with training. Highly recommend and my Charlie recommends it too.

This is a detailed review, but I promise it’s worth the read! About four months ago, I found Bailey on the streets and decided to adopt him. He’s 6 years old and was incredibly sweet and friendly with both dogs and people when we first took him in. However, after he was neutered, Bailey became reactive and aggressive toward other dogs, both on and off leash.

We also learned that Bailey had been living on the streets for a long time and had been abandoned multiple times, which meant he came with some emotional baggage. He struggled with severe separation anxiety, barking for hours when left alone, which led to frequent complaints from our neighbors. Since Bailey goes everywhere with me, the thought of starting a new job and leaving him at home alone left me feeling anxious and overwhelmed. I couldn’t even consider doggy daycare because I was terrified he might get into a fight with another dog.

I was completely overwhelmed—having no experience training a dog, I didn’t know where to start. After countless hours searching for affordable options that combined daycare and training, I finally found Bauser’s.

In just over a month, Bauser’s has transformed life for both me and Bailey. I was initially hesitant to leave him there because I wasn’t familiar with the staff or how things worked, but my worries disappeared after his first day. The team at Bauser’s is incredibly patient, kind, and attentive to both Bailey’s needs and my concerns.

Bailey has already made tremendous progress, especially around other dogs. Bauser’s provides daily report cards detailing what Bailey worked on, areas for improvement, and tips for practicing at home. They also share videos of his training sessions, showing me how to continue the lessons myself. They’ve even started carefully introducing Bailey to other dogs, which has made a huge difference in his behavior outside of daycare.

Most importantly, Bailey loves it there. He’s always so excited when we arrive, and just the other day, he didn’t even want to leave!

His journey is far from over, but I’m beyond thrilled with the progress he’s made so far. I’m deeply grateful to Christine and the entire Bauser’s team for the care, support, and dedication they’ve shown to Bailey. Thank you for everything! 😊

Today was the first meeting we had at Bauser’s Pet Training. After lengthy conversations with Christine on the phone before we met, I didn’t think I could be more impressed. Her patience and understanding of our problems with our new rescue gave us such peace of mind and we are so looking forward to our work with Christine.
Impressed all around. The Johnsons!!!
